description: Kind 11190 Hub announcements in tag form: inbox, one limit tag per name (max_request_age included), r and addr tags, empty content. Author must be the node identity and the signature valid; rejected: no or two inbox, two limit tags of one name, a malformed inbox, limit or r; ignored: unknown tags, unknown limits, a malformed addr, JSON content. ValidateForBillCalls needs a max_request_age of at least 60.
